er_item_locket_desc: An old-fashioned locket with a nearly worn-away line on the back.
er_item_locket_flavor: She pushed it across the counter, her fingers lingering on its edge.
er_item_bracelet_desc: The clasp has been replaced. Fine old scratches remain on the band.
er_item_bracelet_flavor: Lydia set it on the counter as if testing something.
er_line_keep_quiet: (You decide not to mention the crate yet.)
er_line_warning_prompt: (Should you tell her about the man claiming to be her uncle?)
er_line_core_end: The pawnshop stays open. She has work, her mother, and a pile of ordinary worries. She also has a reason to visit that no longer needs explaining.
er_line_coop_buyer: (The goods Eleanor picked sell cleanly. She stands outside the window and gives you a small, satisfied nod.)
er_notice_early_start: Old Echo selected. Eleanor's story will begin on day 12.
er_notice_save_schema: This save uses Eleanor story data version {0}. This mod requires version {1}. Her story is paused and your progress is preserved.
er_notice_save_before_rewrite: This save predates the Eleanor story rewrite. The mod story is paused and your progress is preserved. Load a save started after the rewrite or start a new game to play the current story.
er_notice_old_save: This save has already progressed vanilla Eleanor's story. To protect it, the mod will not take over automatically. On the first shop day, an 'old file' will ask whether you want to reset her line.
er_notice_keep_vanilla: Vanilla Eleanor storyline kept. The remake will not be enabled in this save.
er_notice_reset_arm: Click again to confirm the reset. This will clear vanilla and mod Eleanor story progress.
er_notice_reset_done: Eleanor's story has been reset. Open the store or pass a day to restart. Items you already received will remain.
er_notice_story_inactive: The Eleanor remake is not active in this save (old-save protection or version mismatch).
er_old_prompt_1: Boss, I found an old file on Eleanor while sorting the archive. The upper district has been sitting on her family's case for years.
er_old_prompt_2: You can let the old record stand, or reopen the file. Rewriting it will overwrite the vanilla progress, but you won't lose items you already received.
er_old_prompt_choice_prompt: (He places a blank file on the counter.)
er_old_prompt_reset: Reset Eleanor's story and start the remake.
er_old_prompt_reset_desc: Clears vanilla and mod Eleanor progress. Items you already received are kept.
er_old_prompt_keep_desc: Do not enable the remake in this save.
er_old_prompt_reset_line: (He nods, pulls the old file away, and puts a fresh one in its place. The story will restart the next time you open the shop.)
er_old_prompt_keep_line: (He closes the file and puts it back on the shelf. The old record stands.)
er_route_reset_1: Boss, the road you finished is on record now.
er_route_reset_2: The file can be opened to its first page again. Rewriting clears this run's route progress and starts from your first meeting; items you already received stay, and world effects already in motion such as news and reputation are not rolled back.
er_route_reset_choice_prompt: (He sets the finished file on the counter, its first page blank again.)
er_route_reset_now: Turn the story back to its first page and try another route.
er_route_reset_now_desc: Clears all route progress in this run and restarts from the common line. Items are kept; world effects such as news and reputation are not rolled back.
er_route_reset_later_desc: Keep the current progress; he will bring the file back in a few days.
er_route_reset_keep: Keep this story. Don't ask again.
er_route_reset_keep_desc: Do not offer the story reset again in this save.
er_route_reset_now_line: (He removes the finished file and replaces it with a fresh one. The next shop day starts the story again from your first meeting.)
er_route_reset_later_line: (He puts the file back in his bag. He will come again in a few days.)
er_route_reset_keep_line: (He closes the file and does not open it again. This ending stays as it is.)
er_config_portrait_mode_tip: Auto: native and this mod's story use this mod's portraits; another mod's Eleanor art is kept, and expression switching pauses while it is visible. Force: every mod's Eleanor uses this mod's portrait, overriding another mod's Eleanor art; delayed writes from another mod may briefly flash. Other: use vanilla/other-mod portraits everywhere; this mod does not replace portraits or switch expressions, and its story clients fall back to native keys. A client already in the shop may need the next visit or a reload for a mode change to take full effect.
er_early_start_desc: Eleanor's first visit moves from day 23 to day 12. The rest of her story schedule also moves 11 days earlier.
er_choice_accept_crate: Take the crate and put it on the counter.
er_choice_accept_crate_desc: You can inspect it later, or hand it to her directly.
er_choice_accept_inspect: Take it, but inspect the crate first.
er_choice_accept_inspect_desc: The stolen-goods record will show up. It may also draw attention.
er_choice_refuse_crate: Refuse and let him take it away.
er_choice_refuse_crate_desc: If she never receives it, the trap cannot spring.
er_choice_tell_crate_desc: Let her know it was reported stolen, and not to touch it.
er_choice_keep_quiet: Do not mention the crate yet.
er_choice_keep_quiet_desc: She will not know the danger; the trap remains armed.
er_prompt_drive_custody: (She places the drive on the counter but does not let go.)
er_prompt_confession: (She finishes, and does not look down.)
er_choice_confess_friends: I care about you. But not that way.
er_choice_confess_friends_desc: Friends route; the rescue is not undone.
er_prompt_locket: (She sets the locket on the counter.)
er_choice_refuse_locket: It looks better on you. I'll take the thought.
er_choice_accept_gift_desc: She has started noticing what you need. If there is no room, you can choose again.
er_choice_pay_gift_desc: Pay 20 credits rather than turn her gift into another debt. No charge if it cannot be placed; you can choose again.
er_choice_refuse_gift_desc: She is still saving for the investigator.
er_notice_true_unlock: A complete romance route has been reached.
er_line_coop_buyer_intro: (A little later, the customer Eleanor mentioned comes to the window.)
er_choice_rescue_later: Go back and raise the money. Return tomorrow.
er_choice_rescue_later_desc: She is still inside. You are not done trying.
er_line_uncle_done: (The man claiming to be her uncle has not come back. The counter is clear.)
er_line_end_perfume: This is for you. Don't ask the price.
er_line_scav_assist: When I have time, I'll help you dig at the dump. Two of us can cover more piles, and I'll watch for any scrap that's about to give way.
er_line_cash_aid_1: Get something to eat for you and your roommate.
er_line_cash_aid_2: ...She shared her portion with me yesterday.
er_line_cash_aid_3: The things I said before... I was wrong. I'm sorry.
er_line_cash_aid_4: Eat first. We can talk later.
er_return_gift_retry: The item could not be delivered. Make room and have 20 credits ready if paying; you have not been charged.
er_ending_maid_01: Later, the salon put Eleanor's full name on its posters. After the show people followed her to the door to ask where she'd sing next.
er_ending_maid_02: You did not move to the upper district. The pawnshop stayed open, and her place by the counter stayed hers. After her two nights on stage, she still came down, changed back into the dress made from an old skirt, and finished the day's ledger for you.
er_ending_maid_03: Once, a salon programme found its way between the pages of the ledger. You reached for it. She smoothed it flat first.
er_ending_maid_04: Do you want to hear about the Upper Level first, Master, or would you rather have me to yourself for a bit?
er_notice_savings_complete: The investigation fund has reached 800 credits.
er_ending_content_end: This is the end of this mod's story. You can continue running the shop and its dailies.
er_story_cg_gala_text: During the second song, Eleanor looks past the microphone and finds you in the audience. She keeps her eyes on you until the last note.
er_story_cg_date_text: Let's sit here a little longer.
er_story_cg_love_water_cut_text: Stay for supper. Let me thank you properly.
er_story_cg_revolution_embrace_text: Let me lean on you. ...Just for a minute.
er_op55_c01_prompt: (She stops there. How do you answer?)
er_op55_c01_opt2: Never mind. Let me see the goods.
er_op55_c03_prompt: (The pendant is on the counter. How do you answer?)
er_op55_c03_opt2: I can name a price. Hear me out.
er_op55_c04_opt1: Take it and keep it for her
er_op55_c04_opt2: Ask for papers and log it first
er_op55_c05_prompt: (When she speaks, what do you choose?)
er_op55_c05_opt2: Explain first. How did it come to this?
er_op55a2_c08_prompt: How do you take this piece?
er_prelude_c4_prompt: What do you do about the money.
er_prelude_c1_no_buy: She waits for you to speak.
er_prelude_buyback_wait: She pushes the money across and waits for you to put the bracelet on the counter.
er_prelude_buyback_nosale: The bracelet is still in your hand. She says nothing more.
er_prelude_bracelet_missing: You no longer have the old bracelet to hand over.
er_choice_drive_return_desc: Trade it for her mother; the research goes back.
er_choice_drive_protect_desc: Secure her care first, then publish the research.
er_choice_drive_public_desc: Do not wait; her mother may not survive.
er_choice_drive_keep_desc: Lock the drive under the counter.
er_choice_drive_ask: Ask what else is on the drive
er_choice_drive_ask_desc: Let her finish describing what is on it.
er_choice_threat_refuse: Refuse the money, carry the message
er_choice_threat_refuse_desc: Do not take the three hundred; tell her exactly what was said.
er_choice_threat_throw_desc: Do not take the bait; order him out.
er_choice_post_sit_desc: Let her sit down and rest.
er_choice_post_ask: Ask what she wants to buy
er_choice_post_ask_desc: Ask what she came to buy first.
er_maid_v2_gap_desc: Requires enough cash for the current shortfall. Only the actual remainder is lent after a sale; no sale means no loan.
er_cg_dv13_text: Go mind the counter, and quit looking over here.
er_cg_shop_inside: Eleanor, move the ledger over for me?
er_cg_shop_sign: The open sign's still on the sill. Better bring it in before bed.
er_cg_shop_out: Set the bowls here. We can fit three.
er_cg_shop_caption:
Boss, we're closed.
What are you standing out there for? We saved you supper.
er_cg_knock_farewell: Just to the rail. You’ve got a shop to open.
er_cg_knock_intro: I knock once and you knock right back.
er_cg_knock_rail: I heard you. Going on duty? I’ll walk you to the gallery.
